notes:
`PRODUCT_VERSION` 1.4.1 · `CONTRACT_VERSION` 4.9.0

1.4.1 makes sure you hear about everything waiting on you, and restarting toryo no longer interrupts jobs that are already running.

### Added

- **You're told about everything waiting on you, and the message goes away when it's handled.** Parked jobs, restarts held up by running work, proposed ideas and held memories now each send you a message in Board's inbox, including ones that used to wait silently. A notification can no longer be lost because a service was down when it was sent.
- **Deputy answers questions from running workers**, or brings them to you when it can't. A question nobody answers now waits for a reply. Before, the run went ahead on a default answer.
- **Limit the shell commands an agent may run** with an allowlist, on Claude and Copilot. On Codex and Cursor a run that asks for one is refused rather than run with an open shell. Deputy's own sessions can read your project but only run read-only commands. If a gate or the allowlist changes after Deputy decides, that decision is cancelled.
- **Send messages to a running Claude worker** and it receives them right away.
- **Research runs use a dedicated research persona.**
- **Memory sorts out conflicting memories.** When a new memory conflicts with an existing one, it can replace the old one or flag a tie. A project memory whose files are all gone is marked stale, and deleted memories are removed for good once their retention period ends.
- **Merge two ideas into one.**
- **See which runs depend on a given run.**
- **Board's Deputy screen shows what Deputy is doing right now.** You can also choose how often Deputy checks your runs (every 30 seconds by default).

### Changed

- **Restarting or updating toryo hands running jobs to the new dispatch service** instead of stopping them. Workers still running from before the restart are taken over rather than killed.
- **Deputy reacts as soon as a job finishes** instead of waiting for its next check. Its health shows red when it stops receiving updates.
- **Deputy brings you a plan approval that the task brief doesn't settle**, and it can merge a pull request whose only open review findings are nits.
- **A run stopped by its spending limit can continue in a fresh session.**
- **Queued work that other runs are waiting on starts first.**
- **Run IDs work as a short prefix** of at least 8 characters, and full IDs match whatever their letter case.
- **Board's approval card puts the decision first** and folds the supporting evidence away until you open it. The runs list sorts by any column.

### Fixed

- **Readiness checks no longer pass on stale results.** A gate that a later merge made out of date is held back and checked again. Readiness also handles cancelled CI checks and long lists of changed files.
- **Code-task runs adjust when the base branch moves during a merge**, and commit subjects are checked before anything is pushed.
- **Agents with an output folder can still write files**, and that holds on every harness.
- **Command rules match whole words only**, so a rule for one command no longer catches longer commands that start with the same letters.
- **Read-only agents can't run destructive commands.**
- **Updates install new dependencies and apply pending changes to your stored data** when your source checkout moves.
